source_policy: Frozen beta.4 candidate at exact source commit 5d00039479f2f11b7fe30ccf2385e70ce24553c3. Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and OpenCode exact-candidate transport, installed-byte identity, activation, and invocation evidence were explicitly accepted by 2026-07-31. Accepted beta.1, beta.2, and beta.3 evidence remains bounded to those immutable historical candidates. Private acceptance ledgers and release authorization remain outside the public repository.

status_semantics.PASS: A current native end-to-end install/start/invocation journey was observed on a real host and has a public-safe evidence reference.
status_semantics.NOT_RUN: No accepted current-native live-host journey is recorded in this public projection.
status_semantics.FAIL: A current native end-to-end journey was attempted and failed with a public-safe evidence reference.
status_semantics.BLOCKED: A current native end-to-end journey was attempted but host policy, permissions, or environment prevented completion; a public-safe evidence reference is required.

codex.product_path: Exact-SHA Git marketplace plugin install -> trust bundled SessionStart hook -> start a new thread -> invoke an installed Hakim skill

github-copilot.product_path: Catalog discovery -> exact-SHA GitHub plugin-source install -> verify installed skills/agents -> invoke a Hakim skill
